oracle: Blocks Probe, a new page, new blocks, nothing saved
question: Copy Properties and Paste Properties on the block menu: which rows, when each is grey, and what each does to animations and transforms.
note: A page made for the probe, nothing saved, left by Exit Without Saving. Menus opened by a contextmenu event sent to the block by id (one read by a real right press at a named block's point), rows pressed by exact label on the element that is really on top. Hidden Paste rows stay in the page with a size, so a label alone finds them. Escape does not close this menu; a press on its backdrop does. Blocks were Text, Shape and Button, one on top of the other. Hover trigger only: rows made with the On Hover Grow, Lift and Look tiles.

reads.hoverOpens: Moving the pointer onto Copy Properties, Paste Properties or Arrange opens its rows with no press.
reads.copyTransforms: Always on, on a block with default values too.
reads.copyAnimations: Grey on a block with no animations, on with one or more. A press on grey does nothing and the menu stays open. A press on an on row closes the menu.
reads.afterCopyAnimations: Transforms grey, Animations and Replace Animations on, on the source block too.
reads.afterCopyTransforms: Transforms on, Animations and Replace Animations grey.
reads.oneClip: Copy Transforms after Copy Animations greys both animation rows; Copy Animations after Copy Transforms greys Transforms.

pasteAnimations.ownRowsKept: own row first, then the copied rows: hover-3, hover-1, hover-2

replaceAnimations.own: 1 row before, the 2 copied rows after, in source order

reads.undo: One step for each paste; both ways back read. data-has-block-animations follows the rows.
reads.snapshot: The clip is what the block had at the copy: a third row added to the source later did not paste.
reads.panelSharesClip: After Copy Properties > Animations the panel's Paste animations is on, on a block with no rows. After the panel's Copy animations on a block with 3 rows, Replace Animations pastes those 3.
reads.greyCopyKeepsClip: Pressing a grey Copy Properties > Animations leaves the clip as it was.
reads.blockTypes: Rows copied from Text paste on Shape and Button.
reads.otherSection: The clip reaches a block in another section.
reads.group: With two blocks selected, a real right press on either, first or second, leaves that block alone selected and opens the menu; a contextmenu event does the same. Paste goes to it alone: the other kept its rows or its Transforms. Copy reads the same block: Animations is grey if that one has no rows, whatever the other has.

pasteTransforms.fromDefaults: A clip from a block with default values resets the target to 100%, 0°.

notRead: Whether Transforms in the panel's More actions shares the clip. Ours uses the same one.
Whether the clip outlasts a reload or reaches another page.
Triggers other than On Hover, block types other than Text, Shape and Button as a source.
Whether the parent row stays lit while the pointer is on its rows.
